overview_description.description: Databand provides a software platform for agile machine learning development. It helps data scientists and engineers build solutions fast, iterate easily, and productize improvements. Today, too many obstacles to fast ML development and release exist. Old processes saturate the classic software market with DevOps and CI/CD tools that help teams move code from dev to production, but ML development is different and requires specialized solutions. It addresses this gap with a framework that provides cross-team standardization and complete visibility for all project stakeholders. The company is currently in use by a wide range of advanced ML teams, from publicly traded enterprises to startups.

about_short_description.short_description: Databand provides an observability platform for data and machine learning pipelines.

product.name: Continuous Data Observability Platform
product.description: A platform that detects data incidents, resolves data quality issues, and ensures reliable data delivery.

product.name: Machine Learning-Powered Anomaly Detection
product.description: Uses machine learning to flag data incidents by building a historical baseline and alerting on deviations.

product.name: Data Incident Management
product.description: Manages data incidents from a unified interface, allowing for custom alerts and smart communication workflows.

identifier.value: End-to-End Data Lineage and Impact Analysis

product.name: End-to-End Data Lineage and Impact Analysis
product.description: Provides visibility into data movement and the impact of data incidents on interconnected operations.

product.name: Data Pipeline Monitoring
product.description: Automatically detects incidents in data processes and pipelines, such as missing operations or failed jobs.

product.name: Data Quality Monitoring
product.description: Alerts on data problems like schema changes and duplicates, and visualizes datasets over time for trend analysis.
